Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/upx && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"fuzzers/test_packed_file_fuzzer.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":24,"var":"data,size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary file that UPX will parse as an ELF input."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::PackLinuxElf64help1","line":1010,"var":"ehdri/e_phoff/e_shoff","code":"alloc_file_image(file_image, file_size); ... f->readx(file_image, file_size);","note":"The whole file is loaded into file_image and the ELF header/program headers are interpreted from attacker data."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::PackLinuxElf64help1","line":1038,"var":"dynseg","code":"invert_pt_dynamic(dynseg, umin(get_te64(&phdr->p_filesz), file_size - offset));","note":"The PT_DYNAMIC segment is located and passed to the dynamic-table parser with a bounded headway derived from the file contents."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::invert_pt_dynamic","line":7953,"var":"dynp/dynp0","code":"for (; ; ++ndx, ++dynp) { ... d_tag = get_te64(&dynp->d_tag); ... if (Elf64_Dyn::DT_NULL == d_tag) break; }","note":"Dynamic entries are scanned from attacker-controlled memory and the code records DT_* offsets and the DT_INIT/DT_INIT_ARRAY choice."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::invert_pt_dynamic","line":8004,"var":"symnum_end/hashend/gashend","code":"symnum_end = elf_find_table_size(...); ... hashend = ... elf_find_table_size(...); ... gashend = ... elf_find_table_size(...);","note":"Table-size discovery uses elf_find_table_size, which resolves table bounds through dynamic pointers and section headers derived from the same input."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::elf_find_table_size","line":7928,"var":"x_rva/x_phdr/d_off/y_ndx","code":"x_phdr = elf_find_Phdr_for_va(x_rva, phdri, e_phnum); d_off = x_rva - get_te64(&x_phdr->p_vaddr); y_ndx = find_dt_ndx(...);","note":"The function assumes elf_find_Phdr_for_va succeeds and immediately dereferences x_phdr to compute offsets, so malformed layout can steer later pointer arithmetic."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::invert_pt_dynamic","line":8057,"var":"gashend/buckets/hasharr","code":"unsigned const *const buckets = (unsigned const *)&bitmask[n_bitmask]; ... if (!n_bucket || ... || (unsigned)(gashend - buckets) < n_bucket) throwCantPack(...);","note":"The GNU-hash bounds are validated using gashend, which came from the previous table-size computation and therefore inherits its trust in the attacker-controlled ELF layout."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::pack3","line":3215,"var":"user_init_rp/user_init_va","code":"if (user_init_rp) { Elf64_Dyn *dynp = (Elf64_Dyn *)elf_find_dynptr(Elf64_Dyn::DT_NULL); set_te64(&dynp->d_val, (char *)user_init_rp - (char *)&file_image[0]); }","note":"The later pack path reuses the dynamic-table state established above and writes through a DT_NULL slot selected from the attacker-controlled dynamic array."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::pack3","line":3221,"var":"phdr0/phdr","code":"Elf64_Phdr *const phdr0 = (Elf64_Phdr *)lowmem.subref(...); Elf64_Phdr *phdr = phdr0;","note":"The code materializes a second program-header view for rewriting, based on offsets and sizes derived from the same malformed ELF."},
{"step":10,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::pack3","line":3230,"var":"phdr->p_type","code":"if (PT_LOAD64 == type) { ... } else if (xct_off < ioff) { ... }","note":"The loop walks the rewritten headers and uses the previously computed xct_off/so_slide relationships to decide which headers and offsets to patch."},
{"step":11,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::elf_find_table_size","line":7938,"var":"x_phdr","code":"Elf64_Phdr const *const x_phdr = elf_find_Phdr_for_va(x_rva, phdri, e_phnum);","note":"If the dynamic pointers describe a VA that is not covered by any PT_LOAD, x_phdr can be null and the subsequent dereference becomes the root cause for the crash path."},
{"step":12,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::invert_pt_dynamic","line":8004,"var":"get_te64(&x_phdr->p_vaddr)","code":"unsigned const d_off = x_rva - get_te64(&x_phdr->p_vaddr);","note":"This dereference of x_phdr is the memory-safety sink: a malformed ELF can drive elf_find_table_size to read through an invalid program-header pointer, matching the reported UAF/read crash state."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
